ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, points A, B, and C are all on the lattice points of a $4 \times 4$ square grid. What is the value of $\tan\angle BAC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: As shown in the figure, take lattice point D and connect BD.\\
From the lattice graph, it can be inferred that $BD\perp AC$,\\
Using the properties of lattice triangles, we find: $AD=\sqrt{3^2+3^2}=3\sqrt{2}$, $BD=\sqrt{1^2+1^2}=\sqrt{2}$,\\
$\therefore$ $\tan\angle BAC=\frac{BD}{AD}=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{3\sqrt{2}}=\boxed{\frac{1}{3}}$
